tagline: Collagen Face Wash – Restoring Anti-Aging Facial Cleanser
intro: Refresh, cleanse, and rejuvenate your skin with KB Collagen Face Wash, a restoring anti-aging formula designed to deeply cleanse while maintaining skin’s youthful appearance. Powered with collagen, this face wash helps improve skin elasticity, smooth fine lines, and promote a firmer, healthier-looking complexion.

Its deep-cleansing and acne-control formula removes excess oil, dirt, and impurities, unclogs pores, and gently exfoliates without over-drying. Suitable for all skin types, it leaves your skin feeling clean, soft, and refreshed after every wash.

li: Helps reduce fine lines and signs of aging
Smoothens skin texture and boosts elasticity

p: Apply a small amount to wet face, gently massage in circular motions, and rinse thoroughly. Use twice daily for best results.
Perfect for daily cleansing to reveal smoother, clearer, and youthful-looking skin

full: Collagen Face Wash – Restoring Anti-Aging Facial Cleanser
